subject: Renewal planning: phased commit & per-token ceiling for Acme Data
messages:

Hi Karthik,

Hope youre well. Were approaching our Nov renewal and Q3 usage came in higher than projected (attached summary). Were evaluating whether to right-size our commit vs continuing pay-as-you-go. A couple of asks:

- Can Redwood provide a phased commit option (ramp over 3 months) so we dont overcommit up front?
- Whats the uplifts/ceiling youd allow for renewal increases (we saw references to 10-20% in other threads)?
- If we move to a larger commit, can you confirm the per-token discount breaks and whether higher thresholds are retroactive or apply prospectively?

Looking for a short call this week to align.

Anne

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Anne Keller <anne.keller@acme-data.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 13:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + usage spike questions

Anne, thanks for the note and the CSV. Quick replies below and we can follow up with a short call: 

- Phased commit: yes — we can structure a 3-month ramp (month 1 = 60% of target commit, month 2 = 80%, month 3 = 100%) with true-up at the end of the ramp window.
- Uplift ceiling: our standard guideline is 15% YoY without exec approval; we can make exceptions up to 20% for strategic customers but need commercial sign-off.
- Discounting: per-token tiers are applied prospectively; we can provide a one-time retroactive true-up credit for any usage that exceeds the committed threshold during the ramp period (limited to 1 billing cycle).

Proposed next steps: Ill share a short mutual action plan + SOW draft for your review. If this looks acceptable we can loop in procurement/legal for PO/DocuSign.

Attaching a draft SOW and the usage file you sent (I added a one-line summary). Also linking the HubSpot deal for internal tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2026-02

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal conversation + usage spike questions (Acme) -- exception request

Marissa / Ben, looping you both for quick guidance.

Acme is recommending a right-size to ~75k/month commit (current commit ~50k/month), with a proposed phased ramp and asks for a 20% uplift ceiling exception. Theyre sensitive to being locked in too high given seasonality.

Key numbers Im proposing in the commercial draft:
- Commit: $75,000/mo (12 month term)
- Ramp: 60% / 80% / 100% over first 3 months with end-of-ramp true-up
- Per-token discounts: base tier to 50B tokens = 8% off list, 50-200B = 15% off, 200B+ = 22% off (applies prospectively; we include one-cycle retro true-up credit during ramp)
- Renewal uplift ceiling (exception request): 20% YoY for this renewal only if procurement signs PO within 30 days

Questions:
1) Is 22% top-tier discount something youd sign off on for Acme?
2) Any objections to single-cycle retroactive true-up credit?
3) Should we tie the exception to a pay-term / deposit or require a larger security commitment?

Im happy to take the lead on the commercial call if you want to align beforehand.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal conversation + usage spike questions (Acme) -- exception request

Karthik, Marissa — quick guidance from pricing desk / sales ops:

- 22% top-tier is at the edge but acceptable for strategic accounts if we mitigate risk elsewhere. Approve for Acme with the following controls:
  * Require a PO for the 12-month commit and net-30 payment terms (no extended payment).
  * Include a 3-month lookback clause and a single-cycle retro credit during the ramp (credit capped at the equivalent value of the month in which usage exceeded the commit).
  * For the uplift exception (20% YoY): cap to the first renewal only and add an auto-review trigger at month 6 for usage vs forecast.

- Recommend we include a smoothing clause: if usage volatility > 40% month-over-month during the first 3 months, Redwood reserves right to reopen commercial terms with 30 days notice. This helps protect margins.

Id also offer a small onboarding credit (one-time $5k) if they sign the PO within 14 days — helps close the timing ask.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

  * up to 50B tokens: 8% off list

- Terms: PO required; net-30 payment; onboarding credit of $5,000 if PO received within 14 days
